paper_title: 3D template-based $Fermi$-LAT constraints on the diffuse supernova axion-like particle background
notes: Upper limit on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma <= 3.76e-11 GeV^-1 at 95% CL for m_a << 10^-11 eV, from 12 years of Fermi-LAT data analyzing diffuse SN ALP background converted via Galactic magnetic field. This is a stellar/astrophysical bound (not a haloscope DM search), so no local DM density assumed. Single mass-independent limit point in the low-mass regime; mass plotted as upper bound m_a < 1e-11 eV.
